QuestInfo.name: Luminous, the Final Hero
QuestInfo.0: Ask Tess where you can find Luminous, the final hero.
QuestInfo.1: Tess says to speak to Grendel the Really Old in the Magic Library of Ellinia.
QuestInfo.2: You've located Grendel the Really Old.
QuestInfo.demandSummary: Meet Grendel the Really Old at the Magic Library in Ellinia

0.0: Pirates weren't around the last time the Black Mage attacked. They didn't arrive until Kyrin showed up on Victoria Island much later.
0.1: So, I'm sending you to see Luminous, the final hero.

yes.0: I'm not sure exactly where Luminous is... Head to the Magic Library in Ellinia and speak to #bGrendel the Really Old#k for a lead.

no.0: What do you mean, 'no'? This isn't a joke! Don't be picky about which Hero I send you to!

1.0: What brings you to the Magic Library, young Explorer?

yes.0: It saddens me to hear that such evil has befallen Maple Island...
